title: Yehudah, Son of Rabbi Shmuel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Bamidbar Rabbah 12:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Bamidbar_Rabbah.12.3) mentions his death after seeing Ketev Meriri. [Eichah Rabbah, chapter 1, on Galta](https://www.sefaria.org/Eikhah_Rabbah.1.29), has Yehudah bar Rabbi, omitting Shmuel. [Shabbat 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.38a.6) has Rav Yehudah bar Shmuel speak in the name of Rabbi Abba, who spoke in the name of Rav Kahana, who spoke in the name of Rav; Dikdukei Soferim instead reads Rabbi Shmuel bar Yehudah.

notes.text: The death anecdote, abbreviated Yehudah bar Rabbi reading and the reversed Shmuel bar Yehudah name are retained as separate textual observations.

Bamidbar Rabbah names Yehudah son of Rabbi Shmuel, who sees Ketev, does not fall, and nevertheless dies. The Hebrew of the linked Eikhah passage calls its figure Yehudah bar Rabbi. The supplied Dikdukei Soferim name order remains Hyman’s report.
